lines.zh: 我一步一步走着，金属磕在地上。
lines.en: I stride, metal clanking on the ground.

lines.zh: 我的脚掌很大，踩下去有坑。
lines.en: My feet are big and leave dents.

lines.zh: 关节转一格，我就往前挪一点。
lines.en: I advance one joint-click at a time.
I turn my head to find a target.

lines.zh: 我从碎石堆上踩过去，压碎了。
lines.en: I trample the rubble flat.

lines.zh: 我的手臂摆得不太自然。
lines.en: My arms swing a bit unnaturally.

lines.zh: 我一顿一顿地走，像台旧机器。
lines.en: I lurch along like old machinery.
I walk along the wall, and the wall shakes.

lines.zh: 我打个弯，撞倒了一根柱子。
lines.en: I take a corner and knock down a pillar.

lines.zh: 我的头灯照着前面的路。
lines.en: My headlamp lights the way.

lines.zh: 我不快，但这双腿不会软。
lines.en: I'm slow, but these legs never weaken.

lines.zh: 每走一步，舱里就响一下。
lines.en: Each step rattles something inside me.
I stand still, fans turning slow.

lines.zh: 我抬手挠了挠铁皮脑袋。
lines.en: I raise a hand and scratch my metal head.
My lamp sweeps back and forth.
Lord Pilaf hasn't given the order.
The current hums rather loudly.
I flex my own fingers.
I count the stones in front of me.

lines.zh: 我的膝盖锁住了，得敲一下。
lines.en: My knee locked; I need to knock it loose.

lines.zh: 我把拳头握起来，又张开。
lines.en: I close my fist, then open it.
Nothing worth seeing here.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转动脖子，骨骼是铁的。
lines.en: I turn my neck slowly; its bones are iron.

lines.zh: 一只鸟落在我肩上，我不在意。
lines.en: A bird lands on my shoulder; I don't mind.

lines.zh: 我把手掌翻过来，看了看纹路。
lines.en: I turn my palm over and look at the seams.

lines.zh: 风扇转得慢，像在打瞌睡。
lines.en: My fan turns slowly, like dozing.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，你也太小了。
lines.en: I look down; you're very small.
Scanning. Target confirmed.
What are you doing at my feet?

lines.zh: 我这副身体，是为打架做的。
lines.en: This body was built for fighting.

lines.zh: 你的武器，对我不算威胁。
lines.en: Your weapon isn't much of a threat.
I tilt my head and a gear clicks.
Speak; I understand you.

lines.zh: 我的主人不在，我可以自己决定。
lines.en: My master's away; I can decide for myself.
Three steps back. That's a warning.
My eyes are only two lamps.

lines.zh: 你的脸映在我的铁皮上。
lines.en: Your face is reflected in my plating.
I crouch to see you properly.
Your sweat seeps into my iron shell.
Don't stand three meters dead ahead.
I let my hands hang by my knees, still.

lines.zh: 你数过我的铆钉吗，很多。
lines.en: Have you counted my rivets? There are many.

lines.zh: 我眼睛里有两盏小灯在转。
lines.en: Two small lamps turn inside my eyes.

lines.zh: 你要说的话，我记录下来了。
lines.en: Whatever you say, I'm recording it.
My shell has a dent.
Something sparks in my circuits.
My head's crooked; I need to straighten it.
That jolt made my gears slip.
My lamp flickers twice.
My knee hydraulics leak a little.
I step back and recalibrate.
The armor holds. Don't gloat.

lines.zh: 我听见自己内部有响声。
lines.en: Something rattles inside me.
Any more of this and I'm scrap.

lines.zh: 那个金属零件，给我看看。
lines.en: That metal part; let me see it.
I smell a power source over there.

lines.zh: 你手里那玩意儿会发光。
lines.en: That thing in your hand glows.
With full power I last longer.
I shift a step closer, then stop.
I reach out only to touch.
Can this be taken apart and used?
I brighten my headlamp a notch.
Are you charging that? I'll wait.
That static makes me want to come closer.
One plate of my iron shell dented.
My metal foot scrapes your boot.
I step half a block aside to let you pass.
That knock cost me some paint.

lines.zh: 我被你顶得后退了半步。
lines.en: You shove me back half a step.
My arm blocks your way.
Don't touch the hydraulic lines on my leg.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，声音很响。
lines.en: We collide, and it's loud.
You step on top of my foot.
I steady you before you fall.
Another machine walks up.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，比了比高度。
lines.en: We stand side by side and compare height.
Its paint is newer than mine.

lines.zh: 皮拉夫的铁壳，也懂伙伴。
lines.en: Even Pilaf's iron shell knows partnership.

lines.zh: 两副铁壳靠在一起，很凉。
lines.en: Two steel shells lean together, cold.
Its joints click in time with mine.

lines.zh: 我们一起把路口堵上了。
lines.en: Together we block the junction.

lines.zh: 我们的灯对着闪了两下。
lines.en: Our lamps blink at each other twice.
Who built it? Fine work.
We hold this area together.
I bend and pick up a piece of iron.
This part can be swapped in.
I pinch up the battery.
I stuff it into my chest cavity.
This gear was exactly what was missing.
This robot's workmanship is rough.

lines.zh: 这铁归皮拉夫大人的仓库。
lines.en: This iron goes to Lord Pilaf's stores.

lines.zh: 皮拉夫造的机器，就是我。
lines.en: Pilaf built this machine. That is me.
It's hot; I switch hands.
I'll find a use for these.
Target locked. Closing in.

lines.zh: 你惹了皮拉夫大人的机器。
lines.en: You've provoked Lord Pilaf's machine.
I raise my fist.
Range is good. Beginning attack.
You can't outrun my stride.
This warning is issued once.

lines.zh: 我的引擎升到作战转速。
lines.en: My engine spins up to combat speed.
Your position is logged.
I lower my head to look at you.
Let's fight. Don't waste time.
I've waited long for this order.
The gears engage, and I move.
This area is mine to clear.
Stand still; it'll be easier.
At the hiss of hydraulics, I charge.
Let's fight. Stop dawdling.
I press forward, a meter at a time.
Go left; I turn left.

lines.zh: 我的脚步把地面震得发抖。
lines.en: My steps make the ground tremble.
I raise my arm to slam.

lines.zh: 你躲在柱子后面，我看得见。
lines.en: You're behind the pillar; I can see you.
My lamp never leaves you.

lines.zh: 我算好了三步之后的位置。
lines.en: I've calculated where you'll be in three steps.
Don't run; my legs are long.
I still have power to spare.
Turning your back to me isn't wise.
I press in; the wall will stop you.
Cross this line and I move.
I tighten my fist.
The moment your hand moves, I strike.
This machine doesn't tire.
I lower my head and aim at you.
Turning now won't save you.

lines.zh: 你的步子，一步比一步短。
lines.en: Your strides grow shorter each step.

lines.zh: 一拳下去，地砖陷了个坑。
lines.en: One punch sinks a pit into the paving.

lines.zh: 我的手臂横过去，把你扫倒。
lines.en: My arm sweeps you off your feet.
This stamp shatters the flagstone.
I grab you and hurl you aside.

lines.zh: 我的拳头擦过你的耳朵。
lines.en: My fist grazes your ear.
You block it, and your arm shakes.
I follow with another.
You back to the wall with nowhere left.

lines.zh: 铁臂扫过去，带起一阵风。
lines.en: My iron arm sweeps past with a gust.
An iron palm pins your shoulder.
I held back on that one.
The floor has answered for you.

lines.zh: 我的关节发出很响的一声。
lines.en: One of my joints pops loudly.
The shove lifts your heels off the ground.
Enough; I can't be bothered.
My knuckles are covered in scratches.
The ground shakes and I come down.
A hatch opens and I step out.

lines.zh: 我的头灯先亮，然后是我。
lines.en: My lamp lights first, then the rest of me.
Metal footsteps come from far off.
I stand up out of the ruins.
Someone has activated me.
My engine coughs three times.
Bricks crumble to powder under me.
This machine has been sent here.
I shake the dust off myself.
I straighten up, taller than you by a lot.
Mission begins. I'm here.

lines.zh: 我从舱里跳下来，震了一下地。
lines.en: I drop from the hatch and the ground jolts.

lines.zh: 我的影子比你的人还大。
lines.en: My shadow is bigger than you are.

lines.zh: 我把脚从碎石里拔出来。
lines.en: I pull my foot out of the rubble.
It's roomy enough for me to stand.
I pat the plate on my chest.
I'm late, though not too late.
Fire blisters my paint.
I fall and punch a crater.

lines.zh: 水进了关节，我转不动了。
lines.en: Water's in my joints; I can't turn.

lines.zh: 我的机器人滚了两圈才停。
lines.en: My robot rolled twice before stopping.

lines.zh: 一枚弹打穿了我的肩板。
lines.en: A shot punches through my shoulder plate.

lines.zh: 这股法术让我的线路发烫。
lines.en: That spell overheats my wiring.
Power is at the red line.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我僵住了一瞬。
lines.en: Lightning hits and I lock up for a moment.

lines.zh: 虚空拽着我，我的引擎空转。
lines.en: The void pulls and my engine spins uselessly.
